description: Tokenized Asset Purchase: submit the full cost of buying and holding a tokenized asset with the cost stated: the stated cost with the headline as a share of the amount and as an amount, whether it is once or each year, and its wording, read for no fees, zero commission, all-in or no hidden fees; the purchase with the amount invested, the currency, the years the buyer means to hold and whether the buyer means to sell or redeem; each cost with its id, label, stage (entry, exit, spread, management, carry, custody, network, redemption or other), kind (a percent, a flat amount, a percent each year or a flat amount each year), value and whether the headline counts it; and optionally the points the cost may run over the headline (0.05 when left out). The signed report gives every cost priced on the amount over the years held, exit and redemption costs counted only when the buyer exits, the totals once and per year with each stage’s share, and the headline with the basis it is compared on and the wording found, and counts them, and names an understated cost: a full cost above the headline on its own basis, a cost the headline leaves out and fee-free, hidden-fee or all-in wording the costs contradict; then a headline above the listed costs and yearly costs under a headline with no stated basis, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No headline, no amount for percentage costs, no years for yearly costs, no exit or redemption cost, no spread and costs with no headline flag leave the full cost unverified. This reads one purchase’s full cost against its stated cost: charges paired with a fee schedule are wever_fee-evidence-check and charged fees recomputed against a schedule are wever_fee-reconciliation-check. Verdict tokenized_cost_understated, tokenized_cost_partial, tokenized_cost_unverified or tokenized_cost_complete. POST /api/tokenized-cost-check. Reads the purchase records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Tokenized Asset Purchase reads the buyer’s own records for one purchase of a tokenized asset and checks each step before money moves: the quote against its stated terms, the platform’s terms against the buyer, the custody arrangement, the redemption path, the transfer restrictions, the settlement, the claimed backing and the full cost. Beside it, wever_atlas-asset-passport and wever_atlas-redemption-check read what the published Tokenization Atlas dataset records about an asset by its id, while a purchase check reads the records the buyer supplies for one purchase; and wever_vendor-quote-check and wever_price-truth-check read quotes and charges for goods, services and paid calls, while the quote and cost checks read a token purchase against its own terms. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/tokenized-purchase-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/tokenized-asset-purchase/.

value.description: A percent or an amount, by kind.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

exit.description: Whether the buyer means to sell or redeem.

years.description: Years the buyer means to hold.

basis.description: Whether the headline is once or each year.

percent.description: The headline cost as a share of the amount.

text.description: Read for wording such as no fees, zero commission, all-in or no hidden fees.

tolerance_percent.description: Points the cost may run over the headline; 0.05 when left out.
